narration: Synthetic voice added with Microsoft Edge TTS; audible AAC audio and English captions.
editing: Genuine room history and desk captures edited to 55 seconds. Waiting removed, some motion retimed, actual desk screenshots held for the checks and closing scenes, and staging framed around its content. No additional generation, request or approval was made for this film.
operator_recovery: Switch transport identities mapped using actual participant/client records.
Initial context-envelope proposal normalized without changing model-generated fields or checker policy and sent through actual Switch handoffs.

Mobile paste parser corrected; original human approval messages requeued unchanged, in arrival order, while still recent. The actual release agent rejected the superseded approval and processed the current one.
limitations: Content staging and demonstration copy; deterministic tester and release roles share the controlled host. Hashes bind bytes, not request meaning or an independent host attestation.
